heading: ## Scenario: the installed Driver exposes the eight livespec operations
reason: Integration-tier: the structural gate against THIS repo confirms the eight livespec-<operation> bindings (and only those) ship — the surface the installed Driver exposes.

heading: ## Scenario: core-root resolution honors the operator override
reason: Integration-tier: drives resolve-core-root.sh with the override env set to a prose-bearing path; stdout is that path, exit 0, and no fallback is consulted.

heading: ## Scenario: core-root resolution falls back to the governed-project checkout
reason: Integration-tier: with no override, a project whose .claude-plugin/prose exists resolves to that checkout (exit 0).

heading: ## Scenario: core-root resolution falls back to the project-scope package clone
reason: Integration-tier: resolves to the project-scope pi package clone (.pi/git/.../livespec/.claude-plugin) when it carries prose.

heading: ## Scenario: core-root resolution falls back to the user-scope package clone
reason: Integration-tier: resolves to the user-scope pi package clone (~/.pi/agent/git/.../livespec/.claude-plugin) when it carries prose.

heading: ## Scenario: a clone present but without prose fails loudly rather than resolving
reason: Integration-tier: a clone directory that exists but carries no prose/ makes the resolver exit 1 with a 'no candidate carries a prose' diagnostic rather than resolving a half-fetched path.

heading: ## Scenario: an override that resolves nothing is reported as a configuration error
reason: Integration-tier: an override pointing at a prose-less path (no other candidate) exits 1 with a diagnostic that names it a configuration error and directs the reader to fix or unset the override rather than install.

heading: ## Scenario: an untrusted non-interactive invocation resolves nothing
reason: RESIDUAL — LIVE: attended pi-runtime acceptance, not hermetically testable at integration tier. pi's trust gating (silently ignoring project-local settings/packages for an untrusted non-interactive invocation) is live pi-runtime behavior against a real trust decision; the spec forbids a mocked stand-in. No integration-tier hermetic test can exercise it; verified only in the attended pi acceptance drive.

heading: ## Scenario: the guard blocks a hook-bypassing commit or push
reason: Integration-tier (TS guard suite run by check-extension-quality via `node --test`, driving the guard's exported decide()): blocks the bare --no-verify forms on commit and push (and -n meaning --no-verify on commit).

heading: ## Scenario: the guard blocks an invocation that disables lefthook
reason: Integration-tier (TS guard suite run by check-extension-quality via `node --test`, driving the guard's exported decide()): blocks the LEFTHOOK=0/false disabling spellings (and does not block a legitimate LEFTHOOK value).

heading: ## Scenario: the guard blocks setting a checkout bare
reason: Integration-tier (TS guard suite run by check-extension-quality via `node --test`, driving the guard's exported decide()): blocks the truthy core.bare set spellings (and does not block reading it or setting it false).

heading: ## Scenario: the guard blocks a write at a livespec primary checkout
reason: Integration-tier (TS guard suite run by check-extension-quality via `node --test`, driving the guard's exported decide()): blocks a write tool or a shell redirection aimed into a repo that declares itself the livespec primary checkout (and leaves ordinary worktrees alone).

heading: ## Scenario: the guard passes through a forbidden string carried as data
reason: Integration-tier (TS guard suite run by check-extension-quality via `node --test`, driving the guard's exported decide()): treats a quoted mention or a here-doc body as data, not an invocation — no block.

heading: ## Scenario: a guard error yields a pass-through rather than a block
reason: Integration-tier (TS guard suite run by check-extension-quality via `node --test`, driving the guard's exported decide()): ignores a non-string command and unknown tools — the internal catch yields a pass-through rather than a block.

heading: ## Scenario: prune-history is never auto-activated
